messages:
Ravi: Quick sync on Trace header: proposing a compact ID pill for mobile, copy affordance, and changing primary action to 'Share trace' (permalink first). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ghi789/trace-header
Carmen: compact pill sounds good. For desktop keep inline ID + copy icon. On mobile show pill with first 8 chars + ellipsis.
Noah: dev note: copy should always copy full ID. Debounce analytics for copy events.
Eve: a11y: pill must be a button with aria-expanded and have a clear label. Announce "Trace ID copied" with aria-live. Also ensure 4.5:1 contrast.
Ravi: share menu: default action = Copy link, secondary = Download JSON/CSV. Include checkbox: "Attach spans & logs (increases size)" with size estimate.
Carmen: microcopy suggestions: 'Copy link' and 'Download JSON (includes metadata)'.
Noah: backend will add include_metadata flag and size estimate API.
A11yBot: Auto-check: header contrast low; tap target <44px on current comp. See report https://a11y.report/789
Eve: Action items: Carmen update Figma with pill + responsive rules (due Mon). Noah add API flag + debounce (2w). I'll draft a11y tests and SR messages.
Ravi: thanks — if no objections we land this as the header iteration.
Carmen: lgtm
Noah: lgtm
Eve: lgtm
A11yBot: Follow-up audit queued after new frames uploaded.
